test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a Lions Club, 70% of the members are young and 30% of the members are old. The average age of the old members is 40 years and that of the young members is 20 years. What is the average age of all the members (in years)?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of young members = 70%

Percentage of old members = 30%

Average age of young members = 20 years

Average age of old members = 40 years

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average Age = (Percentage of young members × Average age of young members) + (Percentage of old members × Average age of old members)

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of members be 100 (for ease of calculation).

Number of young members = 70% of 100 = 70

Number of old members = 30% of 100 = 30

Weighted Average Age

⇒ (70/100 × 20) + (30/100 × 40)

⇒ 0.7 × 20 + 0.3 × 40

⇒ 14 + 12

⇒ 26 years

**The average age of all the members is 26 years.**
